column2: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets.
Flip through the new books
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, slowing the casting time of all spells by 50%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.
Generates 20 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.
Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Light, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 155 for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Salvation, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 30 mana every 5 seconds for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Gives the Gift of the Wild to the target's party, increasing armor by 240, all attributes by 10 and all resistances by 15 for 1 hour.
Heals a friendly target for 1,003 to 1,119 and another 1,064 over 21 sec.
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 250 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana when used.
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana when used.
Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 13 to 42 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 103 extra melee attack power. Lasts for 5 minutes.
In Classic this was an Arms talent. Forever teaches it at the trainer.
Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.
Increases damage done by 10 for 6 sec.
Increases ranged attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.
Increases the friendly target's armor by 105 and all attributes by 4 for 30 min.
Increases the friendly target's armor by 150, all attributes by 6 and all resistances by 5 for 30 min.
Increases the friendly target's armor by 25 for 30 min.
Increases the stealth detection of all party members within 30 yds of the Felhunter.
Increases the target's Intellect by 15 for 30 min.
Infuses the target's party with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.
Instantly heals the caster for 872 to 1,032.
New in Forever. Classic had no way to pull totems back.
New in Forever. Drops a saved set of totems in one cast.
Not in Classic Era. Season of Discovery had a rune with this name.
Party members within 15 yards receive an extra 18 to 22 damage to their next Physical attack. Lasts 10 sec.

Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 104 to 134 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Place a frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.
Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 115 for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 210 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 60. Lasts 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.
Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.
Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Stamina by 43 for 1 hour.
Protects the caster, increasing armor by 210, Shadow resistance by 3 and restores 7 health every 5 sec. for 30 min.

Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but increases the time between your attacks by 100%. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

Reduces all damage you take by 20% and you regenerate mana equal to 5% of your maximum mana every second for 15 sec. Your party and raid members within 40 yards will also receive 18% of the mana you receive this way.
Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50%, but increases the time between your pet's attacks by 43%. Lasts 12 sec.
Reduces ranged damage taken by 21 and increases chance to dodge by 10% for 15 sec.
Regenerates all nearby group members for 142 every 2 seconds for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.
